description: Jethos Protocol plugin ecosystem — modular yield strategies on Arbitrum

plugins.name: Morpho
plugins.description: Optimized lending/borrowing via Morpho Blue markets. Earn yield by supplying assets to isolated lending markets with curated risk parameters.

plugins.name: Morpho Vaults
plugins.description: Managed vault strategies built on top of Morpho markets. Automated allocation across multiple lending positions for optimized risk-adjusted returns.

plugins.name: Euler V2
plugins.description: Next-generation modular lending on Euler V2. Access permissionless money markets with flexible collateral configurations and high capital efficiency.

plugins.name: Aave V3
plugins.description: Battle-tested lending and borrowing on Aave V3. Supply tokens to the largest DeFi lending protocol for stable and predictable yield generation.

plugins.name: Uniswap V3
plugins.description: Concentrated liquidity positions and token swaps via Uniswap V3. Powers the protocol's rebalancing engine and cross-token conversions.

plugins.name: GMX V2
plugins.description: Perpetual trading and hedging strategies via GMX V2 on Arbitrum. Delta-neutral strategies to generate yield from trading fees while hedging ETH exposure.

plugins.name: Pendle
plugins.description: Yield tokenization and trading via Pendle Finance. Split yield-bearing assets into principal and yield tokens for advanced fixed-rate strategies.
